function.name: card_games_poker_determine_winner
function.description: Determines the winner in a game of Poker based on the cards in each players' hands. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
在這場比對中，兩位玩家都拿到同樣的牌型——同花（Flush）。  
- 約翰的牌為 8♥、10♥、J♥、Q♥、K♥  
- 邁克的牌為 9♠、10♠、J♠、Q♠、K♠  

比較牌面大小時，先看最高牌：兩人都持有 K。  
接著比較第二高牌：兩人都持有 Q。  
再比較第三高牌：兩人都持有 J。  
再比較第四高牌：兩人都持有 10。  
最後比較第五高牌：邁克持有 9，而約翰持有 8。

因為 9 > 8，邁克的牌更大，**邁克贏得這局撲克**。
message.reasoning: We need to determine winner. John has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's a straight flush from 8 to K? Actually 8-10-J-Q-K is a straight flush (8-9-10-J-Q-K? Wait missing 9♥). He has 8♥,10♥,J♥,Q♥,K♥. That's not a straight flush because missing 9♥. It's a flush (all hearts) but not straight. He has high card K. Mike has 9♠,J♠,10♠,Q♠,K♠. That's also a flush (spades). He has 9-10-J-Q-K. That's also a flush. Compare high cards: both have K as highest. Next compare next highest: Mike has Q, John has Q. Next J vs J. Next 10 vs 10. Next 9 vs 8. So Mike wins because his 9 beats John's 8. So winner is Mike. Provide answer in Chinese.
